product_family: All-in-one marketing automation, CRM, and customer engagement platform with email, SMS, WhatsApp, push notifications, live chat, chatbot, and AI-powered agents (Aura). Includes Brevo Data Platform for customer data unification.

certifications.name: ISO 27001:2022
certifications.proof_quote: Brevo is ISO 27001:2022-certified. Data is protected by multi-factor authentication, IP address whitelisting, and more.

certifications.name: SOC 2 Type I/II
certifications.proof_quote: Brevo's Terms of Service state: 'Brevo does not hold any certification that is not expressly described on the Site.' SOC 2 is not listed on Brevo's official security or data protection pages.

certifications.name: GDPR
certifications.proof_quote: Brevo is fully GDPR-compliant with a Data Processing Agreement (DPA) available. Brevo's DPO is responsible for continued GDPR compliance, and Brevo commits to breach notification within 72 hours.

certifications.name: HIPAA
certifications.proof_quote: Brevo advises that users should NOT use the Services where communications would be subject to HIPAA. Brevo does not offer a BAA (Business Associate Agreement) and does not support HIPAA-regulated use cases.

certifications.name: ISO 27017 (Cloud Security)
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence of ISO 27017 certification on Brevo's website or official documentation.

certifications.name: ISO 27018 (PII Protection in Cloud)
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence of ISO 27018 certification on Brevo's website or official documentation.

certifications.name: PCI DSS (Data Center Compliance)
certifications.proof_quote: All data is stored on secure servers in Tier 3 and PCI DSS certified data centers. Brevo uses PCI DSS-compliant third-party payment providers (Adyen, PayPal, GoCardless, Stripe, Chargebee).

privacy.ai_training_note: Brevo operates an AI Lab and offers Aura AI (AI-powered assistant for marketing, sales, and support). Aura can analyze customer data for trends and personalization. However, explicit policy on whether customer contact data is used to train underlying AI models is not publicly documented. Aura agents run on Brevo's EU-based infrastructure in compliance with GDPR.
privacy.data_region: EU-based (France, Germany primary; Google Cloud Belgium for backup). Customers can opt for dedicated EU data hosting.

security.name: Encryption in Transit
security.value: TLS protocol used for outgoing connections; SHA256 encryption on port 465 for SMTP; all connections encrypted as much as possible

security.name: Multi-Factor Authentication
security.value: MFA available for accounts; IP address whitelisting supported

security.name: Data Backup Strategy
security.value: Data backed up across three geographically distinct servers; replicated at least 3 times in at least 2 different geographic locations

security.name: Data Center Security
security.value: Tier 3 certified data centers; multi-layer firewall; anti-virus and intrusion detection solutions

security.name: Data Retention
security.value: Customer personal data is destroyed or anonymized within 100 days after agreement termination

products.name: Email Marketing
products.data_scope: Customer contact lists, email content, engagement metrics
products.notes: Core product with spam filtering, authentication (SPF, DKIM, DMARC), transactional email via SMTP relay

products.name: SMS & WhatsApp Marketing
products.data_scope: Phone numbers, message content, delivery logs
products.notes: Real-time messaging triggered via API or automation

products.name: Brevo CRM
products.data_scope: Contact records, deal pipelines, interaction history
products.notes: Sales management with custom pipelines, chat, sales automation

products.name: Brevo Data Platform (CDP)
products.data_scope: Customer data unification, audience segmentation, behavioral data
products.notes: Unifies and activates customer data across channels

products.name: Aura AI
products.data_scope: Customer data, contacts, campaign data for AI analysis and optimization
products.notes: AI-powered assistant for marketing, sales, support, and data analysis. Runs on EU infrastructure. Explicit training policy unclear.

products.name: Customer Loyalty Program
products.data_scope: Loyalty points, customer segments, reward redemptions
products.notes: Fully integrated rewards program with mobile wallet

compare.pricing_model: Freemium to enterprise; pay-as-you-go for contacts and sends; tiered plans for features
compare.data_residency: EU primary (France, Germany); Google Cloud Belgium backup; EU data hosting available

flags: No SOC 2 certification despite third-party claims. Brevo's Terms of Service explicitly state they only hold certifications 'expressly described on the Site,' and SOC 2 is not listed.
HIPAA explicitly not supported. Brevo advises users NOT to use the platform for HIPAA-regulated communications. No BAA available.

AI training posture unclear: Brevo's Aura AI can analyze and process customer contact data, but no public documentation explicitly states whether underlying AI models are trained on customer data or if opt-out is available. This should be clarified for regulated use cases.
ISO 27017 and ISO 27018 not held. Only ISO 27001:2022 is certified for cloud/data protection.
